analogy.rationale: Cholinesterase inhibitors act by blocking ACHE/BCHE to raise acetylcholine, so the closest transcriptional match is another acetylcholinesterase inhibitor and then cholinergic/acetylcholine receptor agonists that engage the same cholinergic pathway. These cell lines express little cholinergic machinery, so the overall response should be weak.
